title: HTTP3: Fix field highlights
description:
Several of the offsets are calculated incorrectly for adding to
the tree. Also fix returning whether or not a prefixed integer is
Huffman encoding when the length is contained in the prefix byte
only.

HTTP3: Fix field highlights

Several of the offsets are calculated incorrectly for adding to
the tree. Also fix returning whether or not a prefixed integer is
Huffman encoding when the length is contained in the prefix byte
only.
